Lieutenant to Lord Anduin Lothar | race = Human | class = Paladin | gender = Male | affiliation = [[Lordaeron (kingdom)|Kingdom of Lordaeron]], [[Alliance of Lordaeron]], [[Knights of the Silver Hand]], [[Alliance Expedition]] | occupation = High General of the Alliance Expedition, Knight of the Silver Hand | status = Unknown | mentors = [[Uther the Lightbringer]]''Warcraft II: Beyond the Dark Portal'' manual, ''[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Warcraft_II:_Beyond_the_Dark_Portal_manual#Turalyon Legends of the Land]'', Turalyon }} General '''Turalyon''' was a paladin who served the [[Alliance of Lordaeron|Alliance]] army with distinction during and immediately after the [[Second War]]. A knight of [[Lordaeron (kingdom)|Lordaeron]], he was one of the first paladins trained by [[Uther the Lightbringer]], and was second in command to Lord [[Anduin Lothar]], the Supreme Allied Commander. When Lord Lothar was struck down in combat with [[Orgrim Doomhammer]] during the assault on [[Blackrock Spire]], it was General Turalyon that picked up Lothar's battle standard and broken sword and rallied the army of the Alliance to victory over the Horde, eventually capturing Doomhammer, and driving the orcs back to the Dark Portal. Only a few years later, General Turalyon was handpicked by King [[Terenas Menethil II]] to join an [[Alliance Expedition|expeditionary force]] through the reformed [[Dark Portal]] and into [[Draenor]]. There, it was discovered that [[Ner'zhul]], the elder shaman of the [[Shadowmoon clan]], was planning to use a number of powerful artifacts to open more portals, allowing the Horde to escape and plunder other worlds. The Alliance forces ultimately failed to stop Ner'zhul from opening and escaping into his portals, and the subsequent chaotic energy the portals released began to destroy the planet. Rather than risk Azeroth being damaged by Draenor's destruction, Turalyon selflessly assisted Archmage [[Khadgar]] in destroying the Dark Portal on Draenor. ==Valley of Heroes Monument== {{Book||height=30em|align=left|content=General Turalyon Former Lieutenant to Lord [[Anduin Lothar]]. [[Knights of the Silver Hand|Knight of the Silver Hand]]. High General of the [[Alliance Expedition]] that marched into the orc homeworld of [[Draenor]]. Presumed deceased. Esarus thar no'Darador' - By Blood and Honor We Serve.
